# Aevinite

> Aevinite is a software company in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It builds custom business software, SaaS products, websites and apps, 3D web experiences and AI automation for businesses that want to run better. Tagline: "Software that runs real businesses."

## What Aevinite does

- Web and app development: websites, web apps and mobile-friendly interfaces.
- Custom systems: business software built around how a company actually works.
- Process automation and AI integration: removing repetitive work and adding AI where it helps.
- Cloud platforms and growth infrastructure for products that need to scale.
- 3D and interactive web experiences.

## Work

- [Aevidine](https://www.aevinite.com/#projects): a complete restaurant platform. Guests order from a menu at the table, with the screens the kitchen, staff and owner use to run service.
- Multispeciality hospital website: a trust-first site with services, doctor profiles and appointment information.
- 4D Dish Explorer: an interactive viewer where each dish is a real 3D model you can rotate and explore.
- HackJudge: a hackathon management and judging platform for events, teams, judges and scoring.
- Sweet Bites (Neon Bakery): a scroll-driven 3D showcase.
